newsitem.title: USA: Salomon Bros. names new head of U.S. equities.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Bros. names new head of U.S. equities.

text.p: Salomon Inc's Salomon Bros. said on Friday it had appointed Arthur Hyde as head of U.S. equities in a move the firm said reflected the importance of growing its equity business.
Hyde joined Salomon Bros. in 1982 and has headed the firm's investment grade capital markets, syndicate and trading groups, Salomon Bros said in a statement.

Bruce Hackett, who has headed U.S. equities, will continue as a senior member of the equity department, focusing on institutional investor clients and the management of new technology initiatives, the company said.
